MEMO
To: All warehouse supervisors
From: Gregor Malinowski, Operations Director
Date: 9 September
Re: New inventory scanning system

Beginning on 1 October, Stellan Logistics will replace its handheld barcode scanners with a new wearable system that attaches to the wrist. In trials at our Dortmund facility, the devices reduced picking errors by 30 percent and allowed workers to keep both hands free while lifting.

Each supervisor must attend a half-day training session before the launch. Sessions will be held on 18, 22, and 25 September in the main conference room. Please register for one date through the intranet by 15 September. After completing the training, you will be responsible for instructing the members of your own team.

The old scanners should be returned to the IT department no later than 3 October. Any questions about the transition may be directed to Ines Carvalho in IT.

questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of the memo?
choices: To report problems at the Dortmund facility
To announce the hiring of new staff
To explain the introduction of new equipment
To request feedback about a trial
questions.explain: Bản ghi nhớ thông báo từ 1/10 công ty thay máy quét cầm tay bằng hệ thống đeo cổ tay mới, kèm hướng dẫn đào tạo và trả máy cũ.

questions.prompt: What are supervisors asked to do by 15 September?
choices: Sign up for a training session
questions.explain: "Please register for one date through the intranet by 15 September" — đăng ký một buổi đào tạo trước 15/9. Máy cũ trả trước 3/10.

questions.prompt: What is suggested about the wearable devices?
choices: They will be tested in Dortmund next year.
They are cheaper than the old scanners.
They require a full day of training for each worker.
They may help workers handle items more easily.
questions.explain: Thiết bị cho phép công nhân "keep both hands free while lifting", tức nâng hàng dễ hơn. Thử nghiệm ở Dortmund đã diễn ra rồi, và buổi đào tạo chỉ nửa ngày.

groups.passage:
About Us — Fennimore & Daughters Bakery

Fennimore & Daughters began in 1987 as a single stall at the Ashbury farmers' market, where Ruth Fennimore sold sourdough loaves baked in her home kitchen. [1] Today, the business operates three shops across the county and supplies bread to more than forty local restaurants.

Although we have grown, our methods have changed very little. [2] Every loaf is still shaped by hand, and our sourdough starter is the same one Ruth created more than thirty-five years ago. We buy our flour from two mills located within 50 miles of our main bakery.

[3] In 2021, Ruth's daughters, Clara and June, took over daily management of the company. Clara oversees production, while June handles our wholesale accounts and community partnerships. [4] Each evening, unsold bread from all three shops is donated to the Ashbury Community Pantry.

questions.prompt:
In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong?
“Machines are used only for mixing the dough.”
questions.explain: Câu chèn nói về phương pháp làm bánh, nối tiếp "our methods have changed very little" và dẫn vào "Every loaf is still shaped by hand", nên thuộc vị trí [2].

questions.prompt: What is indicated about Fennimore & Daughters?
choices: It was founded by two sisters.
It opened its first shop in 2021.
questions.explain: Bánh mì không bán hết mỗi tối được tặng cho Ashbury Community Pantry ("unsold bread ... is donated"). Người sáng lập là Ruth, bột mua từ hai nhà máy.

groups.passage:
Text 1: Article
PORT ELLIS (21 January) — Orwin Ferries announced yesterday that it will add a second daily crossing between Hadley Island and Port Ellis beginning on 1 April. Currently, the company's single ferry leaves Hadley Island at 7:00 A.M. and makes its return trip from Port Ellis at 5:00 P.M. The new service will leave Hadley Island at 2:00 P.M. and return from Port Ellis at 9:30 P.M.

Chief executive Sunita Rao said demand had grown steadily since a new hotel opened on the island last year. To fund the expansion, adult one-way fares will rise from $12 to $15, while fares for children under twelve will remain at $6. Island residents holding a valid resident card will continue to travel at half the adult fare.
-----
Text 2: Letter
To the Editor,

I read with interest your 21 January article about the changes at Orwin Ferries. As someone who lives on Hadley Island and commutes to Port Ellis three days a week, I welcome the new crossing. It will finally allow me to attend evening classes at the community college in Port Ellis and still get home the same night.

However, I am concerned about the fare increase. Even with my resident discount, my weekly travel costs will go up noticeably. I hope the company will consider a monthly pass for regular commuters, as many other ferry operators already offer.

Kofi Mensah, Hadley Island

questions.prompt: What is the main topic of the article?
choices: A merger between two ferry companies
questions.explain: Bài báo nói Orwin Ferries thêm chuyến phà thứ hai mỗi ngày và tăng giá vé. Khách sạn chỉ được nhắc tới như lý do nhu cầu tăng.

questions.prompt: After 1 April, what time will the last ferry of the day leave Port Ellis?
questions.explain: Chuyến mới "return from Port Ellis at 9:30 P.M.", muộn hơn chuyến 5:00 P.M. hiện có, nên đó là chuyến cuối rời Port Ellis.

questions.prompt: How much will Mr. Mensah most likely pay for a one-way trip after the fare increase?
questions.explain: Ông Mensah sống trên đảo và có giảm giá cư dân (thư); cư dân trả một nửa giá vé người lớn mới $15 (bài báo), tức $7.50.

questions.prompt: Why does Mr. Mensah welcome the new crossing?
choices: It will let him take evening courses.
It will lower his travel costs.
It will allow him to work on weekends.
questions.explain: Ông viết chuyến mới "will finally allow me to attend evening classes at the community college" mà vẫn về nhà trong đêm.

questions.prompt: What does Mr. Mensah suggest Orwin Ferries do?
choices: Cancel the fare increase for children
Extend the resident discount to students
questions.explain: Ông mong công ty "consider a monthly pass for regular commuters" — vé tháng cho người đi lại thường xuyên.

Text 1: Job advertisement
Tamsin Grove Hotel — Front Desk Supervisor (full-time)

The Tamsin Grove Hotel, a 140-room property in the historic district of Larchmont, seeks an experienced front desk supervisor. Responsibilities include scheduling a team of eight receptionists, resolving guest complaints, and preparing weekly occupancy reports.

Requirements: at least three years of hotel reception experience, including one year in a supervisory role; familiarity with reservation software; and fluency in English. Knowledge of a second language is an advantage. Some weekend and night shifts are required.

To apply, send a résumé and cover letter to Priya Desai, Human Resources Manager, at careers@tamsingrove.com by 30 April.
-----
Text 2: Email
To: careers@tamsingrove.com
From: Lucas Ferreira-Holt
Date: 22 April
Subject: Front Desk Supervisor position

Dear Ms. Desai,
I am writing to apply for the front desk supervisor position advertised on your Web site. For the past four years I have worked as a receptionist at the Coastline Inn in Dunmore, and for the last eighteen months I have led its evening shift team of five. I am comfortable with several reservation systems, and in addition to English, I speak Portuguese and Spanish fluently.

I should mention that I am currently completing a part-time hospitality management course on Saturday mornings until the end of June. I would therefore appreciate it if my weekend shifts could begin after that date.

My résumé is attached. Thank you for your consideration.

questions.prompt: What is NOT listed as a responsibility of the position?
questions.explain: Quảng cáo liệt kê xếp lịch cho tám lễ tân, giải quyết khiếu nại và làm báo cáo công suất phòng hằng tuần; không nhắc đến đào tạo lễ tân mới.

questions.prompt: What is indicated about Mr. Ferreira-Holt?
choices: He has worked at the Tamsin Grove Hotel.
He currently manages a team of eight.
He has more supervisory experience than the job requires.
questions.explain: Vị trí yêu cầu một năm làm quản lý (quảng cáo); ông đã dẫn dắt nhóm ca tối trong mười tám tháng (email), nhiều hơn yêu cầu. Nhóm của ông có năm người, không phải tám.

questions.prompt: Which qualification described as an advantage in the advertisement does Mr. Ferreira-Holt have?
questions.explain: Quảng cáo ghi "Knowledge of a second language is an advantage"; ông nói thông thạo tiếng Bồ Đào Nha và Tây Ban Nha ngoài tiếng Anh.

questions.prompt: Which requirement of the job might be a problem for Mr. Ferreira-Holt?
questions.explain: Công việc yêu cầu làm một số ca cuối tuần, nhưng ông học vào sáng thứ Bảy đến cuối tháng 6 và xin bắt đầu ca cuối tuần sau thời điểm đó.

questions.prompt: In the email, the word “comfortable” in paragraph 1 is closest in meaning to
questions.explain: "I am comfortable with several reservation systems" nghĩa là ông quen thuộc, sử dụng thành thạo các hệ thống đặt phòng (familiar).

Text 1: Program
Northern Retail Innovation Forum — Day 2, Thursday 14 November, Halvorsen Center

9:00–9:45  Keynote: “Checkout-Free Stores” — Dr. Elise Marchetti, Vantor Research (Main Hall)
10:00–10:45  Panel: Sustainable Packaging (Room 2)
11:00–11:45  Workshop: Pricing with Real-Time Data — Rashid Khoury, PriceLoop (Room 3)
12:00–13:00  Lunch (Atrium)
13:15–14:00  Talk: Loyalty Programs That Work — Hannah Brandt, Kellwick Stores (Room 2)

Workshop seats are limited to 30 and must be reserved at the registration desk.
-----
Text 2: Email
To: All registered attendees
From: Forum Organizing Committee
Date: 12 November
Subject: Program update

Please note two changes to Thursday's program. Because of a flight cancellation, Dr. Marchetti will now deliver her keynote by video link; the time and location are unchanged. In addition, Rashid Khoury has asked to swap time slots with Hannah Brandt, so his workshop will now take place from 13:15 to 14:00, and her talk will move to 11:00. Each session will remain in its originally scheduled room. We apologize for any inconvenience.
-----
Text 3: Text-message chain
Joanna Liu [10:48]: I'm outside Room 3 for the pricing workshop, but there's no one here.
Daniel Osei [10:50]: Didn't you see the committee's email? It was moved to the afternoon.
Joanna Liu [10:51]: Oh no. I booked a client call for 1:30.
Daniel Osei [10:52]: Can the call be moved?
Joanna Liu [10:54]: I'll try. If not, could you sit in on the workshop and take notes for me?
Daniel Osei [10:55]: Leave it to me. I've already reserved a seat.

questions.prompt: What is indicated about Dr. Marchetti?
choices: She will speak in a different room.
She will not be present in person.
questions.explain: Email cho biết do chuyến bay bị hủy, bà Marchetti sẽ trình bày "by video link", thời gian và địa điểm giữ nguyên.

questions.prompt: Where will Ms. Brandt give her talk?
questions.explain: Chương trình xếp bài nói của bà Brandt ở Room 2; email nói chỉ đổi giờ, "Each session will remain in its originally scheduled room".

questions.prompt: Why is Ms. Liu concerned?
choices: Her call overlaps with the new time of a session.
She forgot to reserve a workshop seat.
questions.explain: Workshop của ông Khoury dời sang 13:15–14:00 (email), trùng với cuộc gọi khách hàng lúc 1:30 mà cô Liu đã hẹn (tin nhắn).

questions.prompt: At 10:55, what does Mr. Osei most likely mean when he writes, “Leave it to me”?
choices: He will reschedule Ms. Liu's call.
He wants Ms. Liu to leave the workshop.
He agrees to attend the session for her.
questions.explain: Ông trả lời ngay sau lời nhờ dự workshop và ghi chép giùm, rồi nói đã giữ chỗ — tức đồng ý tham dự thay cô.

questions.prompt: Which session can Ms. Liu attend at 11:00?
questions.explain: Theo email, bài nói của bà Brandt "Loyalty Programs That Work" được dời sang 11:00, đổi chỗ với workshop định giá.
